p: Dumbarton Road is Partick's busy main street, a proper Glasgow mix of tenement shops, pubs and takeaways, and it's on the doorstep of some of the best free days out in the city.

Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, with its famous Dali painting and huge organ, is a short walk away, and the Riverside Museum of transport sits on the Clyde nearby, both free and brilliant for families. Byres Road and its cafés are just up the hill too. Admiral itself is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's one for the grown-ups only. With the subway and train station close, it's easy to combine a visit with a West End wander.
